experiment: E12 an edit made outside the app, shown at once
decision: an outside file write reached the staging panel in 27 to 37 ms (median 32.5) instead of 508 to 525 ms, by delivering watcher events after a 25 ms gather and pacing only after a refresh, and starting a frontend read at once after a quiet spell (f87985e8)
scope: debug drive build, one launch per build, page-side DOM change timed by MutationObserver, window occluded so no paint; small scratch repository; not CPU under ignored churn, not the index.lock wait during a real rebase
comparativeVerdict: after faster in every trial, ranges disjoint (after max 37 ms, before min 508 ms)
fixture: scratch git repository with two commits and a.txt, commit.gpgsign false, opened with drive launch; probe files untracked
procedure: per trial: arm a MutationObserver for the probe file name, write the file from Python taking t0 from time.time(), read the page's Date.now() when the name first appears, sleep 1.5 s; twelve trials per build
probe:
#!/bin/bash
# usage: trial.sh <repo> <label> <count>  (TRUNK_DRIVE_DIR set)
set -euo pipefail
cd /Users/joaofnds/code/trunk
drive() { mise exec -- bun scripts/drive/drive.ts "$@"; }
repo=$1; label=$2; count=$3
for i in $(seq 1 "$count"); do
  name="probe-$label-$i.txt"
  drive eval "(() => { const s = { name: '$name', seen: null }; window.__t440 = s; const o = new MutationObserver(() => { if (s.seen === null && document.body.textContent.includes(s.name)) { s.seen = Date.now(); o.disconnect(); } }); o.observe(document.body, { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true }); return 'armed'; })()" > /dev/null
  python3 - "$repo/$name" <<'PY' > /tmp/t440w/t0
import sys, time
open(sys.argv[1], "w").write("probe\n")
print(int(time.time() * 1000))
PY
  t0=$(cat /tmp/t440w/t0)
  seen=$(drive until 'window.__t440.seen || null')
  echo "$label $i $((seen - t0))"
  python3 -c "import time; time.sleep(1.5)"
done
followUp: a commit made in a terminal replaced the committed rows with the new commit row in the graph and left the uncommitted files in the panel, one reading of 486 ms including git and drive client overhead
